in_hebrew.name: חֶרְמִיא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Hermie is derived from the Hebrew word חֶרְמִיא (hermia), which means ‘strong’ or ‘mighty.’ This name carries a sense of power and strength, reminding us of God’s strength and might.

in_greek.name: Ἕρμιος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hermie is derived from the Greek word Ἕρμιος (hermios), which means ‘soldier.’ This name reflects a sense of bravery and dedication, reminding us of the courage and strength that comes from God.

in_latin.name: Hermes
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hermie has no direct equivalent in Latin, but it is related to the Latin god Hermes, the messenger of the gods. This name carries a sense of communication, travel, and divine protection.
